privateProfile.label: Make my profile private

People won't be able to follow you freely; they'll have to send a follow request first.

Only your followers can see your public answers.

delete.title: Delete account

After that, all data related to your account will be deleted. Don't worry: clicking this button opens a dialog where you confirm the deletion.
